data.description: Machine-first FDA PDUFA-catalyst feed for AI agents. Upcoming FDA decision dates assembled from SEC 8-K/6-K filings.

endpoints.coverage: GET /v1/coverage?ticker=XYZ (ticker or cik REQUIRED; a bare call is 400)

contact.report_a_wrong_date: Every record carries the filing that asserted it (source_url) and the sentence we read (source_quote). If those disagree with the record, mail the address above with the catalyst_id and the filing. Repairs publish as a `corrected` event on /v1/events — distinct from `date_extension`, which is the FDA moving the date rather than us having been wrong.
contact.lost_a_paid_response: Settlement is on-chain and completes before the response reaches you, and the signed authorization is single-use — so a dropped connection cannot be replayed for the same payment. Mail the address above with the transaction hash.

related.name: Crypto ETF Sentinel
related.description: Sibling feed from the same builder — SEC EDGAR spot crypto-ETF filing intelligence for AI agents.

limits.note: No hard rate limit is enforced today. Please stay at or below the recommended rate; sustained excess load may be throttled in future.

data.freshness: Upcoming dates are relayed from SEC filings and stand until a newer filing changes them. Per record, `age_days` is how long the row has gone without a change (days since `last_updated`). `feed.last_polled` is when the scan last ran. Cadence: the poller runs HOURLY, so a newly EDGAR-indexed filing normally reaches the feed within the hour (plus EDGAR's own full-text-search indexing lag, which we don't control); a daily catch-up re-scans a trailing 60-day EDGAR window to repair anything an hourly pass missed.

api.deprecation_policy: Breaking changes are announced in the CHANGELOG and, for a retiring route, via `Deprecation` + `Sunset` response headers at least 30 days before removal.

data.disclaimer: Informational only; not investment advice. No warranty. Data is assembled from primary SEC filings; every record links to its source filing and carries a last-updated timestamp. Verify against the primary source before acting.
